vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: deepvista-vistabase-card
Version: 0.1.0-alpha.20

The skill bundle provides a standard interface for managing knowledge cards via the 'deepvista' CLI. It includes well-defined CRUD operations, search functionality, and safety warnings (e.g., [!CAUTION] tags) requiring user confirmation for write or destructive actions. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found; the package installation and URLs (deepvista.ai) are consistent with the stated purpose.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are coherent with a CLI-based knowledge-card manager, but verify the dependent 'deepvista-shared' auth skill and the origin of the deepvista-cli package before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description describe a card manager and the skill only requires the 'deepvista' CLI (provided by deepvista-cli). The declared install (deepvista-cli → deepvista binary) matches the documented CLI commands and subcommands.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only CLI usage for read/write operations against DeepVista and instructs the agent to confirm destructive/write commands with the user. It references deepvista-shared for auth/global flags — the runtime instructions themselves do not attempt to read unrelated files or environment variables.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install uses a 'uv' package: deepvista-cli which will create a deepvista binary. Package-install is a normal mechanism but carries moderate risk if the package source is unverified; no direct download URL or release host is provided in the skill metadata.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: This skill itself declares no env vars or credentials, which is proportionate. However it depends on deepvista-shared for auth; that dependent skill may require API keys or tokens — review deepvista-shared to confirm what credentials will be requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no requests to modify other skills or system-wide config. The skill is instruction-only and does not demand permanent elevated presence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent for controlling a DeepVista CLI. Before installing: (1) Inspect the deepvista-shared skill to see what credentials or tokens it requests (the card skill delegates auth to that skill). (2) Verify the origin and trustworthiness of the deepvista-cli package (where it's published, project repo or releases) because the install will place a binary on disk. (3) Be cautious when confirming write/delete commands — the SKILL.md does ask the agent to execute destructive operations after user confirmation. If you cannot verify deepvista-cli or the auth skill, treat installation as higher risk.
